title: Duolingo/Gamified Learning
content: Apply Duolingo aesthetic with gamified learning feel. Owl mascot and character system. XP and leveling progress. Streak tracking with flames. Leaderboards and leagues. Heart/life system. Lesson completion celebrations. Achievement badges. Skill trees. Audio feedback. Encouraging error states.

variants.simple: Create gamified learning interface with XP, streaks, leaderboards, and character mascots.
variants.detailed: Apply Duolingo aesthetic with gamified learning feel. Owl mascot and character system. XP and leveling progress. Streak tracking with flames. Leaderboards and leagues. Heart/life system. Lesson completion celebrations. Achievement badges. Skill trees. Audio feedback. Encouraging error states.
variants.advanced: Apply Duolingo aesthetic with gamified learning patterns. Mascot: character illustrations with expressions (happy, sad, encouraging), animations on interactions. XP: gain XP on correct answers, animated +10 XP floating up, daily XP goal progress bar. Streaks: flame icon with current streak count, freeze for missed days, milestone celebrations. Hearts: limited attempts system, lose heart on wrong answer, regenerate or buy. Leaderboard: weekly leagues, rank with XP, promotion/demotion zones. Skill tree: units/modules as nodes, paths connecting, completed/current/locked states. Lessons: question cards, multiple choice, matching, typing, speaking. Progress: lesson progress dots, section completion, course progress percentage. Celebrations: confetti on lesson complete, level up animations, badge unlocks. Feedback: green for correct with sound, red shake for wrong with encouragement. Badges: achievement gallery, locked with criteria, earned with date. Tips: expandable lesson tips, grammar explanations. Audio: pronunciation clips, speech recognition practice. Characters: NPCs for dialogs, distinct personalities. Profile: avatar customization with unlockable items. Store: hearts, streak freezes, bonus content. Social: follow friends, share achievements. Push: reminder notifications, streak protection alerts. Accessibility: audio alternatives, keyboard navigation.

author: Ersin KOÇ
